title: Lokše
description: A classic dish from Slovakia, featuring potato, all-purpose flour, lard, unsalted butter. A practical home-kitchen version with measured step ingredients and clear cooking methods.

steps.instruction: Cook the listed ingredients in simmering water for about 24 minutes until tender; drain well if necessary.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Roll or press the prepared dough evenly into the desired thickness and shape.
Heat the pan over medium heat, shape or spoon out portions, and fry for about 12 minutes total until golden on both sides and fully cooked.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
